note: Cases pin the behavior read from item_actions.rs, field_path.rs validate_pattern_field_ref and pattern.rs validate_entity_prop_contract plus the validate_pattern walk; the itemAction, contract and walk cases were checked against `orb validate --json` on real fixtures. The installed registry marks no prop field-ref, so the field-ref cases feed a registry that does (the Rust check reads the same kind and itemKind markers). Entity definitions are the orbitals' primary and auxiliary entities, later replacing earlier, a primary name declared twice dropped.
